full_judgment: 2. The short facts for disposal of the rule are that the schedule property measuring an area of 0.52 acres being under CS Khatian No. 52, Plot No. 86, Mouja-Kumarkhali, District-Kumarkhali originally belonged to Yakub Meah and Yasin Meah by equal share. Subsequently Yakub Meah transferred his 8 anas share to one Latif and thereafter Latif and Yasmin transferred their share to one Suboth Chandra Laheri, who died leaving behind 4 sons. The sons of the Suboth Laheri transferred the land to one Abdul Bari in the year 1948 and since then Abdul Bari was possessing the land by paying rent to the then land lord. The SA Khatial of the said land was recorded in the name of the sons of Suboth Laheri and, as such, Abdul Bari filed Title Suit No.811 of 1969 for declaration of title and correction of SA Khatian and obtained ex parte decree on 29-11-1973 which was not challenged by any other party. Subsequently RS record was prepared in the name of Abdul Bari. Then Abdul Bari sold the properly to the petitioners vide registered deed No. 106 on 5-1-1988 and the petitioners were enjoying peaceful possession of the land by paying rent to the Government. Later the office of the land record refused to receive the land revenue showing ground that the properly in question is a vested property and included in the -kha" list. Thereafter in the year 2005 the respondent No. 4. Deputy commissioner Kushtia filed Title Suit No. 22 of 2005 before the Assistant Judge, Kumarkhali against the R.S. recorded owner Abdul Bari seeking declaration that R.S khatian recorded in the name of Abdul Bari is illegal and wrong and sough correction of the khatian but the suit was dismissed on contest on 16.05.2011.The respondent government did not file any appeal against the said dismissal of suit. Subsequently in the year 2012 the property was shown in the "kha" schedule of the gazette of vested properties published by the government under section 9 of the “অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যার্পণ আইন-২০০১ (সংশোধিত-২০০১) (shortly Act-2001) and the petitioners filed case before the Tribunal, Kushtia for release of the property from "kha list but subsequently government in the year 2013 again amended the said Act-2001 by inserting section 28 ka in the Act by which the gazette notification in respect of "kha" schedule land of the vested properties was cancelled and government left all sorts of interest, title over the schedule "kha" property and all the suits filed for release of the "kha" schedule property were abated as per term of the second amendment of the Act-2001. The petitioners then filed application to the Assistant Commissioner land for mutating the property in the name of the petitioners and to receive land revenue from the petitioners but the same was not disposed of. Later the petitioners somehow came to know that the property in question is being processed to be included in the "ka" schedule of the gazette as vested property. The petitioners then gave a representation to the Ministry of Land and considering the application of the petitioners the respondent No. 3 Deputy Commissioner, Ministry of Land called for a report on 21-1-2014 over the matter. The petitioners then filed this application challenging the action of the respondents starting process to include the petitioners' property in the "ka" schedule gazette of the vested properties and sought direction upon the respondents not to include the same in the -ka" schedule of the gazette of the vested properties.
